description: This file defines a class 'Xml' with static functions for generating, formatting, and validating XML and HTML elements, including utilities for escaping, attribute expansion, and form building. It also defines a class 'XmlSelect' for creating customizable select elements.

classes.name: Xml
classes.description: A utility class for programmatically generating and validating XML/HTML elements with static methods for various element types and encoding features.

classes.name: XmlSelect
classes.description: A class to facilitate the creation of HTML select (dropdown) elements with options and default selection, supporting attribute customization.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Formats an XML element with optional attributes and content, escaping special characters as specified.

methods.name: expandAttributes
methods.description: Generates a string of XML attributes from an associative array, encoding attribute values for inclusion in XML.

methods.name: elementClean
methods.description: Builds an XML element with content cleaned for valid UTF-8 using UtfNormal::cleanUp.

methods.name: openElement
methods.description: Creates an opening tag of an XML element with optional attributes.

methods.name: closeElement
methods.description: Creates a closing tag for a given XML element.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Creates an XML/HTML element with unescaped content, using opening and closing tags.

methods.name: span
methods.description: Creates a span element with specified text and class.

methods.name: wrapClass
methods.description: Wraps text in a specified tag with a class attribute.

methods.name: input
methods.description: Builds an HTML input element with specified name, size, value, and additional attributes.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Builds an HTML password input element.

methods.name: attrib
methods.description: Generates an array with a single attribute for form elements, used in checkbox and radio button creation.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Generates an HTML checkbox input element.

methods.name: radio
methods.description: Generates an HTML radio button input element.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Builds a label element associated with a form input.

methods.name: inputLabel
methods.description: Creates a labeled text input, returning label and input HTML joined together.

methods.name: inputLabelSep
methods.description: Returns label and input HTML segments separately.

methods.name: checkLabel
methods.description: Creates a checkbox input with label.

methods.name: radioLabel
methods.description: Creates a radio button input with label.

methods.name: submitButton
methods.description: Creates a submit button input element.

methods.name: hidden
methods.description: Creates a hidden input field element.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Builds an HTML option element for drop-down lists.

methods.name: listDropDown
methods.description: Generates a full select element with options derived from a textual list, supporting optgroups and pre-selection.

methods.name: fieldset
methods.description: Creates a fieldset element with optional legend and content.

methods.name: textarea
methods.description: Builds a textarea element with specified content and attributes.

methods.name: escapeJsString
methods.description: Escapes a string for inclusion in JavaScript source code, replacing special characters with escape sequences.

methods.name: encodeJsVar
methods.description: Encodes a PHP variable into a JavaScript representation (arrays, objects, primitives).

methods.name: isWellFormed
methods.description: Checks if a string is well-formed XML using PHP's xml_parser functions.

methods.name: isWellFormedXmlFragment
methods.description: Checks if a string is a well-formed XML fragment by wrapping it in a dummy HTML structure.

methods.name: escapeTagsOnly
methods.description: Replaces certain characters in a string with their HTML entity equivalents, escaping only tags and quotes.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds a table-based HTML form layout with labeled fields and optional submit button.
